pivHint: Humans make plans in the HEART, Solomon writes. A loved one on Valentine's Day may be called a ______heart.
winText: You found it. HEART isn't just a word in today's verse — a Valentine is a SWEETheart.
lossText: The word was SWEET. HEART was the pivot — a Valentine is a SWEETheart.
votdVerse: Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
passageText: To humans belong the plans of the heart, but from the Lord comes the proper answer of the tongue. All a person’s ways seem pure to them, but motives are weighed by the Lord. Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
